business_problem: The National Ability Center wanted to expand nationally without losing its community feel, but participant enrollment, marketing, and program planning were constrained by scattered data, manual paperwork, and legacy internal processes built up over decades.
solution_summary: The National Ability Center is using Salesforce as a new participant-and-stakeholder foundation, with Data 360, Marketing Cloud, and Agentforce positioned to simplify enrollment and personalize outreach as the nonprofit scales. Instead of relying on spreadsheets, internal and external servers, emails, and post-it-note processes, the organization is consolidating 40 years of participant, family, therapist, donor, and partner information into CRM profiles that can support clearer reporting and more targeted engagement. Data 360 helps staff understand which programs resonate with which communities, while Marketing Cloud is planned to deliver tailored email, direct-mail, and future SMS communications for participants, donors, and partner organizations. Agentforce then becomes the service layer for the participant journey, answering enrollment questions and removing paperwork friction so staff can spend more time on the in-person experiences that define the NAC brand.
data_flow: Historical participant and stakeholder data is consolidated into Salesforce and Data 360, where NAC can analyze program fit and launch targeted campaigns through Marketing Cloud while Agentforce uses the same profile context to answer enrollment questions and reduce paperwork-driven delays.
business_outcome: NAC expects easier program enrollment, more targeted national outreach, and better internal visibility into participant needs while keeping staff focused on high-empathy community experiences instead of repetitive administration.
metrics: One in four Americans living with a disability

Marketing Cloud is intended to personalize outreach across both B2C participants and B2B partners or donors.
Agentforce is explicitly positioned as a way to preserve NAC's community feel while scaling enrollment volume.
